C-12.Name: Copy as Plain Text: selection without HTML or Markdown markup
C-12.Summary: User request after C-11: "добавил бы еще копировать как плейн текст (без рич и мд форматинга)". Add Copy as Plain Text next to Copy as HTML: renders the selection (or whole document) through the same marked+DOMPurify pipeline as C-3, then extracts textContent — plain text with no HTML tags and no Markdown syntax (headings keep their words, bold loses its asterisks) — and writes a single text/plain flavor via the native clipboard plugin. Exposed in the editor context menu (after Copy as HTML), the Edit menu (CmdOrCtrl+Alt+Shift+C), and the command palette.

Problem.Description: Normal copy yields Markdown source; Copy as HTML yields rich formatting — neither gives clean plain text for chat/notes.
Problem.Evidence: muya copyHandler writes Markdown as text/plain; C-3 handleCopyAsHtml writes html + Markdown text/plain; no textContent-based flavor.

Goals.R-1: editor.vue handleCopyAsPlainText: muya getCopyData (whole-document fallback) → marked with editor options → DOMPurify EXPORT config → DOMParser textContent (inter-block newlines preserved by marked's output) → collapse 3+ newlines → native writeText; failure warns with the anchored marker + notify (no execCommand fallback — muya has no plain-copy transport). Bus event 'copyAsPlainText', subscribed/unsubscribed alongside the other copy buses.
Goals.R-2:
Context menu gains Copy as Plain Text (id copyAsPlainText) right after Copy as HTML; Edit menu gains "Copy as Plain Text" (edit.copy-as-plain-text, CmdOrCtrl+Alt+Shift+C) in m009's native build_native_menu (standard_menu() taxonomy intentionally omits it, matching the pre-existing edit.copy-as-html pattern — the taxonomy has no renderer consumers); command registry + descriptions entry for the palette. Hard breaks (markdown two-space/backslash, and the literal
muya stores in table cells) become newlines before textContent extraction so words never glue together.
Goals.R-3: Locales: contextMenu.editor.copyAsPlainText and commands.edit.copyAsPlainText in all ten locale PAIRS (json + min.json).
Goals.R-4: Tests: editor-coverage pins the strip pipeline ('# T\\n\\n**b**' → 'T\\nb'), context-menu dispatch, and the updated interleaved menu layout; menu-consistency pins the menu id + accelerator with a uniqueness check.

Constraints.Constraint: Reuse the C-3 marked/sanitize pipeline; single text/plain write only.
Accelerator must not collide with existing ones.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Copy as Plain Text puts markup-free text on the clipboard as the sole flavor; Markdown-only source stays on normal copy.
Context menu order: Copy as HTML, Copy as Plain Text; Edit menu carries the item with the pinned accelerator.
Suites green; CUA live check passes.

C-12.VerificationIntent: editor-coverage + menu-consistency pins; CUA: copy from a formatted doc, clipboard_read shows the stripped text.
